ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible surface is composed almost entirely of low-intensity dark pixels with negligible high-intensity white pixel distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 140 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations extracted along the entire posterior boundary, appearing as jagged peaks of 5-15 pixels in amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to both the left and right lobes, tapering from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of yellow-tan circular pixel clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and a sparse group of three individual circular spots in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal extremities of both fluke lobes.
